newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George cuts fixed home loan rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George cuts fixed home loan rates.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Thursday it would cut its one, two and three year fixed rate home loans by up to 0.5 percent with fixed rates now available from 8.25 percent per annum for one year.
St George said the latest rate cut moves its three year fixed home loan rate to 8.5 percent per annum, the cheapest three year fixed rate in the market.
The bank said the rate change is effective September 30, the new rates are available to owner occupier and investor borrowers and include both new and existing customers.
